acceptanceCriteria: Named pitches retain note, accidental, octave and preferred spelling; default twelve-tone equal temperament uses A4 = 440.0 Hz.
A4 accepts 350.0 through 500.0 Hz in 0.1 Hz increments; recalculation preserves identity. Direct frequencies accept 16.0 through 12000.0 Hz in 0.1 Hz increments without a note name.
Written/sounding pitch and reversible transposition preserve identity and spelling; internal numeric values remain locale-independent.
Calculated frequencies retain internal precision and satisfy ±0.1-cent accuracy with deterministic invalid-input handling and boundary tests.
The same domain fixtures pass in package, iPhone and Watch test hosts.
notes: PLAN-002 approved for planning; activation and implementation require separate user authorization.
Detailed scope and cross-Epic acceptance boundaries: docs/Epics/EP-002-Planning.md.
Scope: Packages/JustTonesCore, necessary iPhone/Watch test hosts, architecture and evidence documentation. No audio, persistence, synchronization, catalog content, or authoring UI implementation.
Epic criteria: JT-AC-006, JT-AC-009 and calculation contribution to JT-AC-010. JT-TEST-006/007/008 provide baseline cases; persistence and relaunch remain downstream.
rationale: Establish the tested pitch semantics on which generalized tuning depends.
testSteps: Test default pitch, enharmonic pairs, octave crossings, all supported A4 reference increments and direct-frequency endpoints; reject or explicitly document normalization of invalid inputs.
Compare independently derived frequency fixtures; test reversible transposition, spelling preservation, non-finite inputs and out-of-range results.
Run beta-toolchain package tests; inspect schemes/destinations and run shared fixtures through iPhone and Watch test hosts, recording actual commands and results.
